critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main deck window row' geometry by replacing the uniform dot array with a variable-spacing sequence. Implement a parametric spacing formula where the gap between windows increases by 15% at designated intervals to accommodate door frames, and insert 30% larger gaps (approx. 2x standard) at four specific points along the fuselage length to represent emergency exits.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage side.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck) with specific spacing.

discrepancies.observed: The candidate shows a straight line or lacks the characteristic 'hump' curvature in the window placement.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck window row follows a distinct convex arc towards the nose.

discrepancies.observed: A single vertical break near the front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct forward doors with specific geometric spacing and outlines.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length.
